rubric_items.reason: All eleven known REQs (REQ-1..REQ-11) are traced by at least one story; no assumed REQs.
Stories are small; S-1 bundles display, order, Status-filter independence and zero counts, broad but coherent.
F-1..F-3 fixed: AC4 compares displayed counts with displayed total, last-day inclusion and patient exclusion added. Date-range boundary still lacks a hospital-local time-zone case.
Counts 4/25/3/2 come from REQ-3's example; 20 and 21 derive from the 20-per-page rule in REQ-10.
Clear, consistent status terms; S-4 regression ACs still rely on 'as before the change' instead of an observable outcome.
